ItemID: NA; Title: 16 Biggest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me little reason to expect the seasonal or vocal music I have been choosing.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Greatest Hits Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist listed, I cannot tell whether this fits my taste, so I would pass.
ItemID: NA; Title: Precious Memories; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: It does not clearly connect with my recent interest in Christmas albums and vocal groups.
ItemID: NA; Title: 34 Number Ones; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A collection of chart hits is not enough to interest me without knowing the performer.
ItemID: NA; Title: ICON; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This title gives me too little information to choose it during a brief visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lb - Crash My Party; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in vocal harmonies right now than a country party album.
ItemID: NA; Title: Greatest Hits II; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot connect this unspecified compilation to the music I have recently enjoyed.
ItemID: NA; Title: 20th Century Masters: The Millennium Collection - The Best of Lesley Gore; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for a collection of older pop singles on this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lead With Your Heart; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The Tenors' vocal sound appeals to me, but I would leave this for another visit and try just one album now.
ItemID: NA; Title: PTX, Vol. 1; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Pentatonix's layered vocal harmonies fit my interest in Straight No Chaser, so this is the album I would try.
